paragraphs: Farragut sells property tax and workers' comp software to the leaders who run those programs. Assessment is the core of the property tax work, with tools meant to serve each stage of the mass appraisal lifecycle.

An appeals product is meant to make appeals season smoother and more accurate for assessors and property owners alike. A business intelligence product is offered for visualizing data and making better informed decisions. For GIS departments the company offers ParcelSync Pro and DeedSync. The company says customers keep full ownership and control of their property tax solution and can tailor it to their own needs.
Farragut dates itself from a founding in 1992. It describes growth over the past three decades. The name is taken from Admiral David Glasgow Farragut, a 19th-century naval officer.

quote.text: Simplify property tax appeals for assessors and property owners and transform appeals season into a smoother, more accurate, less chaotic and stressful process for everyone.
